## [Unreleased]

### Added

- Project scaffold: Tauri 2 + Solid + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4
- pnpm + Cargo workspace layout (`apps/`, `crates/`, `packages/`)
- `go-media` crate: `PlaybackEngine` trait and media domain types
- `go-subtitles` crate: canonical subtitle document, SRT/WebVTT parsing
- `@go-player/contracts`: typed IPC contract types
- Tooling: mise/pnpm version pinning, setup scripts, CI, release workflow
- ADR-0001: libmpv as the playback engine
